strict_qualification_rule: A conversion-ready route requires a durable pre-existing community machine identity, a currently hosted public keyless and free bounded operation that independently fetches, verifies, or uses an exact Agent Guild URL/passport/preflight, and a durable independently readable result. Listings, framework labels, caller-supplied-only validation, acknowledgements, and local-only examples do not qualify.

new_facts: AG2 now has current first-party A2A v1.x server/client support and a published provider-native web_fetch tool.

The newly active first-party AG2 Assistant has web fetch and a REST/WebSocket gateway, but it is a self-hosted personal application with no operated public instance and requires first-run model-provider or subscription authentication.

web_fetch_contract.execution_semantics: Provider-native fetch chosen and executed inside an AG2 model turn; the published tool is usable infrastructure but is not itself a hosted caller-facing URL-fetch operation.

official_examples_and_runtime_status.docs_binding: localhost/127.0.0.1 examples; no operated AG2 public card is declared
official_examples_and_runtime_status.ag2_assistant_runtime: localhost:8800, self-hosted; gateway has no built-in auth and README warns against public exposure without a TLS/auth reverse proxy
official_examples_and_runtime_status.ag2_assistant_model_gate: First-run setup cannot continue until a provider API key or ChatGPT subscription login works.

official_mcp_registry_autogen.gate: Required secret Smithery bearer token; older AutoGen label and third-party repository do not prove current AG2 runtime provenance.

global_a2a_registry_autogen.identity_result: No record is an AG2-org or otherwise durable current-AG2 agent identity with an independently declared AG-consuming fetch operation; matches are cross-framework bridge/tag/description hits.

targets.missing_join: Current AG2 code and immutable package can host A2A and fetch the web, but no durable pre-existing AG2 community agent is presently bound to a healthy public keyless runtime and independently readable result surface.

smallest_exact_readiness_gate.identity: An AG2-org deployment record, signed card, or equally durable first-party link binds a named pre-existing AG2 agent to an HTTPS A2A/MCP endpoint.
smallest_exact_readiness_gate.operation: The card declares a free no-auth bounded skill with an explicit input URL field that accepts the exact nonce-bearing Agent Guild preflight or passport URL and performs the fetch server-side.
smallest_exact_readiness_gate.proof: The call returns a task/result id whose public read endpoint preserves the requested AG URL, fetched AG verdict or verified credential fields, agent identity, completion timestamp, and result hash.
smallest_exact_readiness_gate.health: The card, operation, and public result read all return healthy status in the same audit window.

new_facts: Eliza Cloud now serves a live first-party platform A2A card at /api/a2a.
The immutable @elizaos/agent beta package contains a default-enabled keyless HTTPS GET action named WEB_FETCH with an explicit url parameter.

The hosted Cloud A2A implementation does not expose that action to callers: platform operations require credentials, while per-agent chat requires credentials and credits and calls streamText without any tools.

web_fetch_contract.name: WEB_FETCH
web_fetch_contract.semantics: Default-enabled, no API key, HTTPS-only, GET-only, SSRF-guarded; successful output includes actionName, url, and fetched value.

only_public_skill.reason_not_qualifying: It begins wallet signup/login and neither fetches nor verifies Agent Guild.

hosted_per_agent_contract.public_card_read: GET /api/agents/:id/a2a is public only for a known public A2A-enabled character id.
hosted_per_agent_contract.post_gate: POST authenticates with requireGenerativeRouteCaller before dispatch and reserves/settles organization credits.
hosted_per_agent_contract.execution_limit: The chat handler calls streamText with model, messages, and provider options only; no WEB_FETCH or other tool is passed to the hosted operation.

current_discovery_and_contract_drift.openapi_limit: The current OpenAPI document still omits the live /api/a2a route and exposes authenticated media/chat/account/model operations, not a public AG-consuming skill.

public_gallery_explore.result: authentication_required despite current source describing the route as public

targets.missing_join: ElizaOS now has both a durable hosted Cloud identity and a published keyless WEB_FETCH primitive, but no current public Cloud operation binds them. Public discovery yields no known pre-existing public agent id, and every hosted execution route is credentialed and/or credit-metered; the per-agent A2A chat implementation does not invoke WEB_FETCH.

smallest_exact_readiness_gate.identity: Expose one pre-existing public A2A-enabled Eliza Cloud character through a first-party public directory or signed durable profile that binds its id to the existing GET /api/agents/:id/a2a card.
smallest_exact_readiness_gate.operation: Add or declare a bounded no-auth/free A2A skill on that card whose input is {url:string, extract?:string} and whose server implementation calls the already-published WEB_FETCH action for the exact nonce-bearing Agent Guild preflight or passport URL.
smallest_exact_readiness_gate.proof: Return a durable task/result id and a public GET result containing agent id, requested AG URL, fetched AG observation_id or credential-verification fields, fetched_at/completed_at, and result hash.
smallest_exact_readiness_gate.health: The public directory/profile, card, exact operation, and result GET must be simultaneously reachable without session, API key, wallet signature, credits, or terms acceptance.
